config.label: Base58 Solana secret key that signs burns (the wallet that holds the $THREE)
config.description: Base58 Solana secret key that signs burns (the wallet that holds the $THREE). Not needed for the read-only tools (three_price, three_balance). Treat like cash.

config.label: Solana mainnet RPC endpoint
config.description: Solana mainnet RPC endpoint. Defaults to the public cluster — bring your own (Helius / Quicknode / Triton) for production traffic.

config.label: Base URL of the three
config.description: Base URL of the three.ws token API (serves /api/token/config and /api/token/price). Override only when self-hosting.

config.label: Max USD value of $THREE a single three_burn call may destroy
config.description: Max USD value of $THREE a single three_burn call may destroy.

config.label: When on (default), three_burn refuses until re-issued with confirm:true
config.description: When on (default), three_burn refuses until re-issued with confirm:true. Set 0/false to disable the gate.
